## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes (or explain what could not be run)
- [ ] Content still works without JavaScript, WebGL and three.js (if this touches the scene, reveals or nav)
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated if behaviour or config changed
- [ ] Generated files regenerated if needed: `npm run vendor`, `npm run security:sync`, `npm run build:og`
- [ ] No new runtime dependency and no new runtime network request
